authority_note: Compiled by hand from docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md (owner-approved, standing development authorization). The roadmap states what to achieve; slices are bounded, ordered steps toward it.

capabilities.capability: Online retrieval and evidence adapter with a stable provenance contract: bounded on-demand source extraction, expiring content-hashed cache, exact offset-bearing excerpts, validated evidence bundles.
The local vector index is an optional, lazily imported capability outside the default research path.
Prove a Research Report's Core evidence path works end to end from online sources with no pre-ingested corpus, preserving citation provenance, source identity and uncertainty.

slices.objective: Prove and document the corpus-free provenance contract: a ke-online-evidence/v1 bundle produced by online-research validates with online-evidence-validate using only its bounded cache, and failed, unavailable or not-permitted sources are recorded with a reason and never quoted.
acceptance: a test builds a bundle with retrieved, failed and unavailable sources and validates it from the cache alone
every excerpt carries source identity, retrieval time, content hash and exact character offsets
cache cleanup and disk-limit behavior are asserted, and no pre-ingested corpus exists in the test
docs/core_interface_contract.md states the bundle fields the AI and Web layers may rely on
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Pin the ke-online-evidence/v1 consumer contract with a committed golden bundle fixture and a compatibility guard, so the AI and Web layers can verify their readers against Core without a corpus and any breaking field change in Core fails a test.
acceptance: a deterministic golden bundle fixture (retrieved, HTTP-failed and unavailable sources, with its bounded cache payloads) is committed under tests/fixtures/ and validates through online-evidence-validate with no network and no pre-ingested corpus

a test pins the required top-level, source and excerpt field names and types (source identity, UTC retrieval time, SHA-256, exact character offsets, failure reason) and fails if a field is removed, renamed or retyped; additive fields are allowed
the fixture round-trips: regenerating it from the deterministic builder yields byte-identical JSON, and the test asserts failed or unavailable sources are never quoted
docs/core_interface_contract.md names the fixture path and the additive-only compatibility rule consumers may rely on
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
runner_requirements: python 3.11+ with the repository's locked dev dependencies installed
no network access: loopback/local fixtures only
free local libraries already used by the repository only

slices.objective: Prove the shipped command path end to end from a question to a validated evidence bundle: run the ke-research online-research and online-evidence-validate commands as subprocesses against a loopback HTTP source server, with no pre-ingested corpus and the vector stack unimported, as the Core half of the AI/Web integration proof.
acceptance: a test starts a local loopback HTTP server serving a citable page, a failing endpoint and an oversized page, runs online-research as a subprocess with a temporary bounded cache, and then runs online-evidence-validate on the produced bundle with exit code 0
the produced bundle contains an excerpt with exact offsets that match the served bytes, a recorded failure reason for the failing source, and a recorded disk-limit refusal for the oversized source
after cache cleanup the same bundle fails validation closed, and the test asserts no corpus, database or PDF files were created in the working directory
the subprocess run is asserted not to import faiss, qdrant_client, sentence_transformers or torch
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
runner_requirements: python 3.11+ with the repository's locked dev dependencies installed
loopback networking only; no external network access
free local libraries already used by the repository only
verification: AC1 loopback server (good page, HTTP 500 endpoint, oversized page), online-research then online-evidence-validate as subprocesses with exit 0: tests/test_online_cli_end_to_end.py::test_online_research_cli_end_to_end_on_loopback_without_a_corpus (harness: tests/test_online_cli_harness.py)
AC2 exact excerpt offsets vs cached served bytes, 'HTTP 500' failure reason, 'exceeds MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES' refusal with no oversized content cached: same test

AC4 subprocess import snapshots assert none of faiss, qdrant_client, sentence_transformers, torch imported (FORBIDDEN_MODULES in tests/test_online_cli_harness.py): same test

slices.objective: Publish a formal, machine-checkable JSON Schema for the ke-online-evidence/v1 bundle that mirrors knowledge_engine/online_evidence.py's own field, type and enum enforcement, exported through a new `ke online-evidence-schema` command, so the independent consumer implementations already built in knowledge-engine-ai (knowledge_engine_ai/copilot/online_evidence_adapter.py) and knowledge-engine-web (knowledge_engine_web/online_evidence_orchestration.py) can validate their own parsers against Core's canonical contract instead of relying on hand-copied field names drifting out of sync with Core.
acceptance: a committed JSON Schema document (docs/schemas/online_evidence_v1.schema.json) declares the required top-level, OnlineSource, EvidenceExcerpt, Citation and EvidenceClaim fields, types and enums (status, stance, claim status) matching online_evidence.py, versioned alongside the ke-online-evidence/v1 schema string

a test validates the existing committed golden fixture (tests/fixtures/online_evidence/bundle.json) against the schema using a minimal pure-stdlib checker (no new third-party JSON Schema dependency), and fails if a required field is missing, renamed or retyped; additive optional fields are allowed

a schema-drift test fails when OnlineEvidenceBundle/OnlineSource/EvidenceExcerpt/Citation/EvidenceClaim's own required fields diverge from the schema document's declared required fields, so Core cannot silently break the contract without the schema and the test both catching it
`ke online-evidence-schema` prints the schema JSON to stdout by default and writes it to a `--output` path when given, exits 0, and a test exercises both modes
docs/online_evidence_contract.md and docs/core_interface_contract.md name the schema file and the command, and state the additive-only compatibility rule the schema enforces
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
runner_requirements: python 3.11+ with the repository's locked dev dependencies installed
no network access: loopback/local fixtures only
free local libraries already used by the repository only

slices.objective: Add a `ke online-evidence-export-contract <dir>` command (and an importable knowledge_engine.online_evidence helper) that writes the current golden bundle fixture, its paired contents/ retrieval files, and the committed JSON Schema from core-online-evidence-json-schema-v1 into a caller-supplied directory in one deterministic call, so knowledge-engine-ai and knowledge-engine-web can pull Core's exact current contract artifacts into their own test suites instead of the undocumented hand-copy each repo did independently, and detect drift the next time they refresh.
acceptance: the new command/function writes byte-identical copies of tests/fixtures/online_evidence/bundle.json, its contents/ directory, and the committed JSON Schema document to a caller-supplied directory, creating it if absent
exporting into an existing non-empty directory refuses to overwrite and fails closed with a clear message, unless an explicit --force flag is given
a test asserts the exported files are byte-identical to the committed fixture and schema, and that the no-overwrite refusal is exercised without --force
a test asserts the exported bundle still validates with online-evidence-validate and against the JSON Schema from core-online-evidence-json-schema-v1
docs/online_evidence_contract.md documents the export command as the integration surface knowledge-engine-ai and knowledge-engine-web use to refresh their own contract-test fixtures
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
